description: This file defines a controller class 'Reward' that manages the display of customer reward points and reward history in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles user authentication, data retrieval, and page rendering for the reward page within the user's account area.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing the customer reward points page, including authentication, data gathering, and view rendering within the account section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language files, checks user login, retrieves reward data, sets up pagination, and renders the reward view page.
